mass_check_vs_tables_S1_S2.note: Table S2 holds the tail constant at 2C10 across all eight linkers and every row agrees as printed, which pins L1-L8 independently of any tail. The six anomalous S1 rows admit several mass-degenerate relabelings (a CH2 moved between linker and tail changes neither mass nor formula), so no single explanation is asserted. The enumerated STRUCTURES are the same under all of them.

table_S1_anomaly: Table S1 prints two rows as 400-L6-C6 (471.7 and 516.7) and two as 113-L6-C6 (both 744.0). The 516.7 row matches the L7 product, so the second pair is mislabelled in the paper; only the L6 masses are used here.
